gen-gf-revalia-gf-mukta: Loud, loose and a bit theatrical, Revalia spreads its wide-set letters out with an open-tailed g. Mukta, a plain sans with tall small letters, keeps things tidy underneath.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-mukta-mahee: Revalia strides across the line in a relaxed, bold display voice. Mukta Mahee backs it with chunky, tall lowercase letters in sans-serif form, friendly and clean, so the loud heading never feels cold.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-mukta-malar: Mukta Malar reads in a plain sans manner, neutral and approachable, with ascenders cut noticeably short. Revalia is the one to flaunt a bold, widely spaced display look, while Mukta Malar quietly handles the everyday reading.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-mukta-vaani: Mukta Vaani brings a contemporary, high-waisted lowercase that keeps its voice level and unfussy. And Revalia, bold and expressive with its open-tailed g, sits above it like a showman next to a quiet sans.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-narnoor: Expressive is the first word for Revalia, a bold display face with a relaxed stride between its widely spaced letters. Narnoor, a sans with short ascenders above big bowls, keeps the text businesslike, while Revalia earns its keep at big, short sizes.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-display: Revalia lays down a bold, expressive heading, its letters spaced wide and its g left open at the bottom. And Noto Sans Display follows in a plain sans with a big, tall middle zone, approachable and easygoing.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-play: Revalia brings a bold, expressive display look, with a relaxed stride and a tall band of letters under short stalks. Yet Play sits beside it in sans-serif, barely varying between cases, its strokes thinning gently without going spindly.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-port-lligat-sans: Bold and expressive, Revalia stretches its widely spaced letters out with a g that stays open below. Port Lligat Sans is the opposite, a modern sans with packed-tight characters and bowls left unfinished on one side, and that tension is the strongest thing here.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-ramabhadra: Ramabhadra reads as a plain sans, clean and businesslike, with a prominent x-height that fills each line. Ramabhadra against Revalia's bold, widely spaced display letters makes a sharp split between showy and sober, and that split is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-rambla: Big personality, wide stride, open-bottomed g. Rambla keeps a long passage smooth in sans-serif, its small letters standing almost as tall as capitals, so the lines read cleanly and without fuss.
